newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FAI plans commercial property trust float.
newsitem.headline: FAI plans commercial property trust float.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd, responding to an article in The Australian Financial Review newspaper, said on Tuesday that it planned to float a commercial property trust in the near future.
The insurance company and funds manager did not provide further details but the newspaper said FAI planned to float a A$200 million parcel of office buildings in Sydney and Melbourne.
It said the float, to raise A$150 million with another A$50 million in debt, was likely to be underwritten by ANZ Securities and offer a first-year yield of nine percent.
